question: What claim about the totality of yoginīs requires a single all-field group to be assigned to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: All earth-moving yoginīs are in view.
All sky-moving yoginīs are in view.
A single all-field group belongs to them collectively.
inference: The collective field-group is assigned to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs together.
uncertainties: The structure of that all-field group is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: The all-field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
